facts.label: Going to e will
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to para planos: The doctor is going to check it. Use will (’ll) para ofertas e previsões: I’ll bring you flowers. I think you’ll like it.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Para planos e coisas combinadas, use am/is/are going to + verbo: The doctor is going to check it tomorrow. I’m going to leave on Friday.

facts.label: Ofertas
facts.sub: Para ofertas e decisões na hora, use will: I’ll bring you flowers. I’ll drive you home. Depois de will, use sempre o verbo base.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Going to talks about plans or things we see.
Will + verb is used for offers.
We say “I’ll to bring a book”.
items.why: We say I’ll bring a book.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Going to talks about plans or things we see. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Will + verb is used for offers. → Verdadeiro (Yes: I’ll bring you…)
We say “I’ll to bring a book”. → Falso (We say I’ll bring a book.)

pages.title: A big hospital · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Wednesday afternoon in a big hospital in Chicago. The hall is bright and clean. Lia walks to room twelve. Her friend Uma is in bed with a hurt leg. Lia knocks on the door. Uma smiles.
“Hi, Lia! Thanks for the visit. I’m happy to see you.” says Uma. “Hi, Uma! How is your leg?” says Lia. “Better. The doctor is going to check it tomorrow.” says Uma.

He is ___ now. → leaving
We ___ every day. → drive
